answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 757 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the saffron log publishes the live set and the basalt audit records each lapse. Keeping 101 aliases alive hence means 101 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the hollow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
